entries.title: Ezra 7:1
segments: Artaxerxes; Artaxerxes Longimanus, the second king in order after Darius.  He must not be confounded with the Artaxerxes mentioned in

, etc. 
 
  Ezra; he was the grandson of the high-priest who was slain at the taking of Jerusalem,
, and was a descendant of Aaron.

entries.title: Ezra 7:6
segments: Scribe in the law; one skilful in writing the law and in instructing the people in its meaning,

. 
 
To be scribes well instructed in the things of the kingdom of God, and able to teach others, men must devote themselves to this work, and seek that preparation which comes from him only.

entries.title: Ezra 7:8
segments: In the seventh year of the king; consequently thirteen years before the mission of Nehemiah.

entries.title: Ezra 7:12
segments: When rulers and those in authority are led to promote the cause of God, his people should view it as the fruit of his grace, and render to hm their tribute of gratitude and praise.

entries.title: Ezra 7:20
segments: Bestow it out of the king's treasure-house; from the people west of the Euphrates.

entries.title: Ezra 7:21
segments: Rulers who not only favor the cause of God, but use their influence to gain the cooperation of others, may expect a blessing on themselves and their fellow men.

entries.title: Ezra 7:27
segments: Blessed be the Lord God; the exclamation of Ezra in view of what God had done for him and the Jews, especially in inclining the king to favor them.
